parameters.description: The store ID which is generated unique numeric identifier.

parameters.description: The inventory system is used by the store. Valid values are, -2 = Non-ATP (Default value), -3 = No inventory, -4 = external inventory management system, -5 = DOM inventory system.

parameters.description: Orders with payment in declined state longer than this many seconds are candidates for cancellation.
parameters.name: rejectedOrderExpiry

parameters.name: priceRefFlags

parameters.description: The payments subsystem AVS result codes.

parameters.description: The time period in seconds for which return merchandise authorization (RMA) calculations are valid. If this time period elapses before an RMA is completed, charges or credits and approval will be recalculated.
parameters.name: RMAGoodFor

parameters.description: Specifies whether the order blocking feature is in use. The order blocking feature can be disabled for this particular store by setting this field to 0. The default value is 1.
parameters.name: blockingActive

parameters.description: Allows the merchant-extensible code for order blocking to be run asynchronously. This column can be used when a merchant wants to test for blocking conditions by connecting to external systems. To enable this feature, this column must be set to 1. By default, it is turned off (that is, set to 0).
parameters.name: blkExtAsynch

parameters.description: This indicates whether remember me session is enabled or not. The default value is 0 (disabled).
parameters.name: persistentSession

parameters.description: Amount of time before the requested ship date when inventory allocation should be performed.
parameters.name: allocationOffset

parameters.description: The maximum period of time that can be requested for a future ship date after the date the requested ship date is entered.
parameters.name: maxFoOffset

parameters.description: Indicates whether order change history tracking is enabled. The default value is Y (Yes).
